# Kola

> Kola is a free invoicing web app for freelancers and small businesses in French-speaking West and Central Africa (Bénin, Sénégal, Côte d'Ivoire, Togo, Cameroun…) and the diaspora. It creates invoices, quotes and receipts with OHADA-style mentions (IFU/NINEA, RCCM, VAT, amount in words), shares them on WhatsApp with a payment link showing the seller's Mobile Money numbers (MTN MoMo, Moov, Wave, Orange Money), and tracks who still owes money. Free plan: 10 documents/month. Pro: 2,500 FCFA/month. Kola never holds the money; customers pay the seller directly.
